source.title: Where Winds Meet’s climactic Hutuo Battlefield narrative arc revealed, out Nov 13
source.evidenceText: October 27, 2026October 27, 2026 Where Winds Meet’s climactic Hutuo Battlefield narrative arc revealed, out Nov 13 1 0 35 Like this When empires crumble and all hope seems lost in the blood-soaked mud, what keeps you fighting? Eric Zheng Head of Where Winds Meet Publishing Today, we are proud to unveil the most climactic narrative arc in Where Winds Meet yet: Hutuo, a sprawling new region launching November 13 alongside the game’s first global anniversary update. Marking a major turning point in Where Winds Meet, Hutuo invites you onto an epic, war-torn frontier to experience a story of unwavering conviction, camaraderie, and the true meaning of heroism. Play Video Defining ‘Xia’: From martial arts to universal heroism When we first set out to build Where Winds Meet, our aspiration was to reimagine Wuxia—a genre long confined mostly to classic cinema—as a living, breathing Jianghu for a global audience. Nothing has moved us more than seeing wanderers worldwide find their own resonance within this realm: discovering what ‘Xia’ truly means through personal awakening, sacred promises, and the enduring longing for freedom. We reached an unforgettable milestone this August when the game welcomed over 100 million players worldwide and claimed Best Mobile Game at Gamescom. Being the first to bring an authentic Wuxia open world to the global stage has been a deeply humbling journey, proving that the spirit of this genre speaks to hearts across every border. Yet our vision goes beyond combat choreography and ancient traditions. With Hutuo, we wanted to delve deeper into the spiritual core of ‘Xia’ (Chivalry)—exploring how sacrifice and guardianship reflect a universal heroism that resonates across all cultures. Nowhere is this clearer than in the story we tell at the battle of Zhongdu Bridge. Here, you step into a desperate historical crossroads: northern invaders are surging across the border, frontline defenses are fracturing, and old pacts lie in ruins. With displaced civilians behind you and an unstoppable tide of steel ahead, loyalty and justice pull in opposite directions. A haunting question arises: when the powers above fail, do you fight in blind obedience to a crumbling throne, or rise alongside sworn companions to shield the innocent and guard your homeland? How you answer that call captures what we believe is the truest, most profound essence of ‘Xia’. The Hutuo Battlefield: Uncovering light in the ashes To anchor this theme, we shifted our world design to craft an authentic, mud-and-steel warzone unlike anything seen in the game before. We focused heavily on immersive environmental storytelling and quest design, allowing players to experience the wartime Jianghu from varied perspectives. Whether stepping into the shoes of a conflicted soldier defying brutal orders, listening to a haunting song of displaced survivors among the river reeds, or witnessing nameless folk risk their lives to shelter refugees in the night, each tale captures a distinct facet of the frontier. Even in the darkest corners of history, we wanted these intimate stories to uncover the enduring light of ordinary lives, showcasing the quiet dignity and everyday bravery of people surviving the storm of war. Immersive warfare: PS5 & PS5 Pro enhancements To make every clash across this frontier feel immediate and visceral, we have tailored dedicated technical upgrades for PlayStation players: PS5 Pro & enhanced PSSR: Utilizing enhanced PSSR alongside upgraded ray-traced reflections, Hutuo’s rivers and wetlands look more striking than ever at a stable 60 FPS, bringing fire and falling ash vividly to life across uneven, mud-soaked reflections beneath your feet. Tactile combat & responsiveness: DualSense adaptive triggers and haptics lend physical weight to every drawn war-bow and clashing blade, while reduced frame hitches during effects-heavy battles keep your parries, combos, and dodges razor-sharp. Seamless battlefield scale: Optimized asynchronous asset streaming drastically cuts load times across fast-travel points, dungeons, and cinematic transitions—ensuring your charge into Hutuo’s core warzones remains smooth and uninterrupted. Yuen Woo-ping’s dual spears & a historic first anniversary Experiencing the emotional peak of Where Winds Meet goes hand-in-hand with our biggest celebration yet. Arriving November 13, our first anniversary update delivers the most generous historic rewards since launch, alongside fun and tactical new board game modes like Horse Racing Chess and Jianghu Tactics. The celebration continues on late November with the debut of the Dual Spears Martial Art. Directed and choreographed by legendary action director Yuen Woo-ping (Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon), this dynamic style alternates fluidly between offensive Light Spears and stance-breaking Heavy Spears, building Spear Stance for relentless combo loops. Want an early look at the front lines? Tune in to our First Anniversary Special Broadcast on November 2, where our team will share deeper developer insights and exclusive gameplay reveals for Hutuo. source.title: ‘90s style sci-fi horror Derelikt launches Nov 13 on PS5
source.evidenceText: November 2, 2026November 2, 2026 ‘90s style sci-fi horror Derelikt launches Nov 13 on PS5 2 0 27 Like this Solo dev Philipp Jensen reveals the secrets behind the title, which emulates PSOne-era aesthetic. Philipp Jensen Creator and Art Director of Derelikt, Visuwyg Back in 1999, gaming was good. Games that were released late in the original PlayStation generation squeezed the last drop of performance out of the hardware, resulting in impressive visuals and all-time classics whose sequels we still play today. Fast forward 26 years and we’re excited to announce that our sci-fi horror game Derelikt will make you feel like your console shed 5 generations when it launches on PlayStation 5 on November 13. Play Video Derelikt takes place aboard Von Neumann Outpost, grafted onto an anomalous asteroid discovered in Saturn’s orbit. Things are rough. The work is hard, home is a million miles away, and people are stressed out. Plus, a mysterious drone is driving everyone closer to their breaking point… You arrive as an outside contractor tasked with finding out the fate of Excavation Team Delta, who went missing on the derelict surface. What you discover turns things from bad to worse fast! The halls are dark, the systems are failing, and the survivors that you come across aren’t telling the same story. Nailing that feeling of not being able to trust those around you, while simultaneously coming face to face with truly out-of-this-world horrors, was paramount for us. The Von Neumann Outpost is well stocked with an arsenal of traditional weapons, and as you progress, you might even find a few more outlandish weapon prototypes and even alien weapons at your disposal. There are also over a dozen to interact with in Derelikt, each featuring their own secrets, and agendas. Some are useful, some are dangerous, some are doomed, and some (let’s be real, most) are all three! We wanted to not only create this horrifyingly tense world full of scary moments and fast gunplay, but also make sure to make managing resources, exploration, dialogues and old-school puzzle solving a core part of the tension experience. Derelikt is very much inspired by the PSOne-era of sci-fi horror, and it feels like a full-circle moment to be writing this today. The goal was to make it appear as if we found Derelikt on a CD-R in the dusty, long-abandoned storage unit of a defunct late-90s developer and simply ported it to modern platforms. I’m of the firm opinion that retro doesn’t have to mean crude and primitive, and I set out to create the most faithful homage to 5th generation graphics available on the market. Our game features 100% lovingly hand-painted textures and vertex colour lighting. Affine Texture warping was deliberately implemented and mitigated in the next step by dynamically subdividing the geometry – just like the most high-end games of the era did – and the game also features retro-style full-motion CGI cutscenes. This way, a delicate balance was achieved – Derelikt looks aesthetically pleasing while still conceivably plausible on period hardware. Our team made a conscious effort to implement modern game design while keeping the core feeling and charm of that era of sci-fi horror intact, including an option for players to toggle on or off effects to match their particular taste. Derelikt has been in development in some form since late 2021 and has had a turbulent and exciting development journey. We hope the game is as wild a ride for players as it has been to develop! source.title: Warhammer Survivors
source.evidenceText: Slide 1 of 7Fantasy Violence, Mild BloodGamesWarhammer SurvivorsReleases 11/10/26VersionNintendo Switch 2EditionDigitalSale ends: 11/18/26 at 07:59 a.m. UTCFantasy Violence, Mild BloodLoadingWarhammer Survivors is a fast-paced roguelite survivors' game, pitting a host of iconic Warhammer characters against endless hordes of enemies from multiple Warhammer factions. Developed by Auroch Digital (Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun) in partnership with Warhammer and poncle (Vampire Survivors), discover the universes of Warhammer 40,000 and Warhammer: Age of Sigmar in all its pixel glory in this new surviv-a-ton.FEATURES - Fast and frantic Survivors gameplay. - A roster of iconic characters from the Warhammer 40,000 and Warhammer: Age of Sigmar universes, featuring Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun’s very own Malum Caedo! - Multiple modes and stages from across the grim, dark 41st Millennium and the Mortal Realms. - An arsenal of familiar weapons, such as the Boltgun, Astartes Chainsword, Whirlwind Axes and easter eggs such as the humble pot of Nuln Oil. - A mighty cache of passives and power-ups to aid in enduring against the monstrous legions. - Esoteric secrets to uncover and collectables to collect! UNLEASH DESTRUCTION ACROSS TWO UNIVERSES Choose your universe and engage in frenetic battles across the open and ashen plains of Aqshy to the tight and confined corridors of an abandoned Space Hulk. Every stage is a new arena of slaughter, each with its unique enemy faction... and secrets to uncover.LEGENDARY CHAMPIONSSelect from a roster of renowned champions from both the Warhammer 40,000 and Warhammer Age of Sigmar universes. Play as the mighty Space Marine Sternguard Veteran, Malum Caedo, and the lightning-forged Stormcast, Neave Blacktalon, among a host of others. Each character comes with unique weapons and starting stats – no two survivors play the same.AN ARSENAL OF ICONIC WEAPONS Wield an arsenal of iconic weapons drawn from the armouries of the far future and the Mortal Realms. Eviscerate Tyranid hordes with a chainsword, or pulverise enemies with the unrelenting Bolter... and, if all that doesn’t work, drown them in a pot of Citadel Nuln Oil paint. Mix and match weapons with power-ups and evolve them into devastating new forms to create screen-clearing storms of bullets, blades and magic.ENDLESS HORDES Obliterate the skittering, beady-eyed Skaven and their horde of warp-addled abominations or stand your ground against the ravenous Tyranid swarm and its myriads of monstrous Xenos Bioforms. Bring your weapons to bear against the endless hordes of these factions (and more) from the Warhammer 40,000 and Warhammer Age of Sigmar universes!META PROGRESSION Death is not the end for these champions of endless war. A growing roster of unlockable characters, weapons, abilities and rare relics will increase your odds of survival.Software description provided by the publisher.Explore this game's official websiteRelated tagsActionPixel artRaise your statsStart over if you failSurvivalShow moreAbout this itemGame file size (estimated)Nintendo Switch: 600 MBNintendo Switch 2: 600 MBSupported play modesTV modeTabletop modeHandheld modeNo. of playersSingle system (1)Nintendo Account family-group lendingSupportedNintendo Switch OnlineSave Data CloudPlay online, access classic NES™ and Super NES™ games, and more with a Nintendo Switch Online membership.
